name: ModelVariant151_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant151_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (30 rings are launched one after another from a slot part towards points on a circle in front of the other slot, growing and turning as they fly, joined into a textured tube, with sparks brightening around every third point of each flying ring); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the ring and its 30 targets, packs two texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before two thirds of the first flight, 4 while rings are still launching, 1 once after the last launch, 0 until the flight ends and then 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-168 and 298 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and bind its data names 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
